name: skills-marketplace-sample
description: A lightweight, self-hosted Claude plugin & skills marketplace.

plugins.name: expense-assistant
plugins.description: Turn receipts and card statements into a submitted expense report. Groups charges, applies the right spend categories, itemizes hotel folios, and flags anything that needs a receipt or an explanation before you file.

plugins.name: meeting-summarizer
plugins.description: Summarize meeting notes or a transcript into decisions, action items, and owners. Turns a messy recap into a short summary anyone can skim, with clear next steps and due dates.

plugins.name: travel-concierge
plugins.description: Search and book corporate travel and manage your itineraries. Find flights and hotels within policy, confirm bookings, pull up your trip details, and cancel plans that change — all from the conversation.

plugins.name: sales-followup
plugins.description: Draft personalized follow-ups and keep your CRM pipeline current. Writes tailored follow-up emails after a call or meeting, reviews open deals, and logs activity and next-step tasks so nothing slips.

plugins.name: hr-policy-helper
plugins.description: Answer employee questions about leave, benefits, and workplace policies in plain language. Explains how a policy applies to a person's situation and points them to the right next step or contact.

plugins.name: contract-review
plugins.description: Review contracts and flag risky or non-standard clauses. Reads an agreement, highlights terms that deviate from your playbook, and suggests plain-language questions to raise before signing.
